drills.name: Chin tucks
cues: Slide the head straight back, as if making a double chin

drills.name: Upper trap stretch
cues: Ear towards the shoulder, other hand sits on the chair

drills.name: Doorway pec stretch
cues: Elbow at shoulder height, step through slowly

drills.name: Wall slides
cues: Back, head and arms touch the wall the whole way

drills.name: Thoracic extension over a chair
cues: Hands behind the head, lean back over the chair back

drills.name: Open books
cues: Knees stacked; follow the top hand with your eyes

drills.name: Cat-cow
cues: Move one segment at a time

drills.name: Half-kneeling hip flexor stretch
cues: Squeeze the glute of the back leg; tuck the pelvis under

drills.name: Couch stretch
cues: Back knee against the wall or sofa; stay tall

drills.name: 90/90 hip switches
cues: Rotate from the hips, chest up

drills.name: Seated figure-four stretch
cues: Ankle over the other knee, hinge forward from the hips

drills.name: Standing hamstring sweep
cues: Heel out, toes up, sweep the hands to the floor

drills.name: Wrist circles and flexor stretch
cues: Fingers back, gently press the palm away

drills.name: Calf raise with a stretch
cues: All the way up, slowly all the way down off a step
